def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = None
    # Separator color is the color forming complete rows/columns.
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        if any(all(v == color for v in row) for row in grid) or any(all(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h)) for c in range(w)):
            sep = color
            break
    if sep is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(w): out[r][c] = 2
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h): out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
